title: When the Recipe Burns
author: Petra Yarrow
blurb: Ulyana Lockridge, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
